# The cost budget and a restart in the middle of a backfill. Each day of 3 tickets reserves 1 cent, and the budget is 5 cents. Chunks hold 4 days.
# The first chunk loads 4 days and the second loads 1, then the reservation of day 6 is refused and the backfill waits for a person.
# The obee process dies in that wait. The next run replays to the same wait, a person adds 20 cents, and the rest loads. No day is labeled twice.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

pipeinit
pipefakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PIPE_DIR=$WORK/pl
env PIPE_HOME=$WORK/pipe
replace pl/version.star 'CHUNK = 100' 'CHUNK = 4'

exec obeereal item add pipeline bf-1 --title 'February' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run bf-1 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star &
waitstatus 'paused: The budget of 5 cents is spent'
kill -KILL
wait

# Five days are loaded, the sixth is not, and the stand-in agent ran five times.
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest'
stdout '^5$'
grep -count=5 '^classify ' calls.log
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT SUM(est_cents) FROM spend'
stdout '^5$'

# The new process reaches the same wait. It does not call the agent again. The answer raises the budget.
exec obeereal run bf-1 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star &
waitstatus 'paused: The budget of 5 cents is spent'
grep -count=5 '^classify ' calls.log
exec obeereal answer bf-1 20
wait
stdout 'item bf-1 finished'

grep -count=12 '^classify ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-02-01$' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-02-06$' calls.log
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest'
stdout '^12$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT SUM(est_cents) FROM spend'
stdout '^12$'

# A person who answers stop ends the backfill with the days that the budget covered.
exec obeereal item add pipeline bf-2 --title 'March' --body-file body2.txt
exec obeereal run bf-2 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star &
waitstatus 'paused: The budget of 2 cents is spent'
exec obeereal answer bf-2 stop
wait
stdout 'item bf-2 finished'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest WHERE day LIKE "2026-03-%"'
stdout '^2$'

-- body.txt --
2026-02-01 2026-02-12 5
-- body2.txt --
2026-03-01 2026-03-06 2
-- pipe/config --
SOURCE_API=http://source.test
-- pipe/credential.header --
X-Token: TESTONLY
